title: How the FCC’s New Rule Will Affect Robot Vacuums
summary: Robot vacuums won't get removed from the market, and your current robot vacuum won't stop working. The FCC updated its Covered List this week to include foreign-made advanced mobile robots, which include robot vacuums.
